C.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common (often least common) denominator for two fractions and express each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator
A step scales numerator/denominator to rewrite fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing a common denominator between two different denominators

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions by subtracting numerators over a common denominator (including the special case of already-equal denominators).
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction once fractions share a denominator (e.g., a/d − b/d = (a−b)/d)
A step subtracts identical fractions to obtain zero
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator or converting forms without performing the subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing the resulting fraction

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the computed result in an accepted simplest form by reducing fractions and/or converting to an integer or mixed number when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step recognizes and rewrites a result as 0, 1, or another integer (e.g., 8/8 = 1, 0/3 = 0)
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number as an equivalent final form
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the subtraction without any reduction or form conversion
Only converting inputs (mixed/whole) before subtraction

A.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number like a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and generate equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for unlike denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to rewrite fractions over the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing unlike denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed with a common denominator (including subtracting whole and fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a shared denominator (e.g., a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b)
A step subtracts mixed numbers by separating whole and fractional parts and combining the result
exclusion_criteria: Only performing conversions to common denominators without actually subtracting
Only simplifying/reducing the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express an equivalent final form (integer or mixed number) consistent with the computed value.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step recognizes a result equals 0 or 1 (e.g., 0/3=0, 8/8=1) or converts an improper fraction to a mixed number
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the subtraction without any reduction or final-form conversion
Only finding a common denominator or converting mixed numbers

B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and related forms like whole numbers) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction with a chosen denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) to rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for unlike denominators
A step scales numerator/denominator to convert fractions to the common denominator (e.g., 5/6 = 15/18)
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing unlike denominators

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the subtraction once quantities are expressed compatibly (e.g., same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately and combines the result
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms (mixed ↔ improper) or finding a common denominator without performing the subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the result in an accepted simplest form by reducing fractions and/or converting between improper fractions, mixed numbers, and integers when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step recognizes and rewrites results like 0/3 → 0 or 8/8 → 1
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or notes the mixed-number equivalent)
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the subtraction without any reduction or form normalization
Only finding a common denominator or converting inputs before subtraction
